title: O! Know Ye Not That Ye
description: O! Know Ye Not That Ye in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Johns wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 280, “Purity”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O! know ye not that ye The tem-ple are of God? Re-vere the earth built shrine, where He Should find a meet a-bode!

lines: O! know ye not that ye
Revere the earth-built shrine, where He
Let hate of all that's dark endure,
Like glories through the temple thrown,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: John Johns died in 1847.
credits: Words by John Johns (1801–1847), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
